title: fog
description: Add or remove fog settings file.

victim.title: victim
victim.description: A `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify which player perceives the fog.

userprovidedid.title: userProvidedId
userprovidedid.description: Required. A `string` that identifies the fog to use.
